design_brief_zh: 主卖点为TSA密码锁，采用“家庭旅行中的场景收益”角度：一家人在旅行途中自然拉着YWJ 13A旅行箱并微笑互动，画面传达便于海关快速查验的实际便利，不使用安全绝对化表达。PC画布为2000×2000，移动端为1200×1200；两端均按“上方场景、下方文案”的阅读顺序。产品主体位于PC [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]、移动端同为[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，应清楚呈现真实箱体比例、竖条纹聚碳酸酯/ABS硬壳、铝合金框架、四个防撞角、轮组和可见的TSA密码锁，优先使用Sliver银色版本，避免混用颜色或尺寸。底部文案区为PC和移动端[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，预留德语约20%的横向扩展空间。标题置于文案区最上方，对应“标题”；下一行对应“支持说明”，说明TSA密码锁便于海关人员快速查验；第三行对应“证据/细节1”，明确配备TSA密码锁；第四行对应“证据/细节2”，明确箱内为涤纶材质内衬。场景中让锁位于视觉焦点附近，可通过自然视角或轻微近景突出锁体；为证明内衬，可在不破坏主场景的前提下加入小型真实开箱细节或局部内衬展示，但不得改变产品结构。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色、自然日光和柔和阴影；字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题和事实信息高对比、清晰易读，移动端需重新调整字号与行距，确保四行均不被人物或产品遮挡。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的TSA密码锁、便于海关快速查验和涤纶内衬事实；不得暗示官方认证、全球安全保障或绝对防护，不使用竞品标识、虚构测试、评分、促销信息或无法验证的承诺。
image_prompt_en: Create a square Amazon lifestyle visual for a YWJ 13A travel suitcase, with the upper 53% dedicated to a realistic European family travel scene and the lower 31% left as a clean reserved copy area. Show a smiling family naturally pulling one accurately rendered silver suitcase through a modern airport or city travel setting. Match the supplied product appearance: vertically textured hard shell, polycarbonate and ABS construction, aluminum frame, four protective corners, visible TSA combination lock, and correct wheels and proportions. Make the TSA lock clearly visible near the family’s hand and suitcase closure. Include a subtle, realistic small interior detail or partial open-view inset showing the polyester lining without creating a second visual focus. Use low-saturation neutral colors, natural daylight, soft shadows, premium modern travel photography, and credible everyday interaction. Keep the product dominant in the upper product region [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53] and keep the lower text region [0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31] uncluttered with a calm, high-contrast background. Compose separately for 2000x2000 desktop and 1200x1200 mobile while preserving the same top-scene/bottom-copy hierarchy. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, labels, price graphics, or certification marks in the image.
